acts.title: The Bill Comes Due
acts.purpose: Viewer understands why a tax on paper mattered more than dock duties and sets up the three boxes.

acts.title: A Tax on Every Desk
acts.purpose: Viewer grasps how the Stamp Act worked as a direct, reach-everywhere tax that broke self-taxation.

acts.title: From Mob to Law
acts.purpose: Viewer sees how intimidation killed enforcement and assemblies made it constitutional.

acts.title: What Actually Worked
acts.purpose: Viewer learns why the nonimportation boycott and Daughters of Liberty forced merchants to lobby for repeal.

acts.title: Virtual vs Actual
acts.purpose: Viewer distinguishes Parliament's virtual representation from colonial actual representation and consent.

acts.title: Repeal With Fine Print
acts.purpose: Viewer understands repeal in early 1766 came linked to the Declaratory Act claiming power in all cases.

acts.title: Three Boxes Landed
acts.purpose: Viewer locks in definitions of all three boxes and avoids exam traps about sides and claims.

acts.title: AP Check and Aftermath
acts.purpose: Viewer applies actual representation, authority versus price, and hollow victory to AP prompts.

visuals.prompt: Embossing press crunches slowly into paper, fibers compressing under pressure.
